mapper.insert: insert into dws_daily_package_all_lab_retention(dates, pkg, `version`, config_group_type, config_group_id, register_dates, register_day, retention_user_num) select lr.dates, lr.pkg, lr.register_version version, dul.config_group_type, dul.config_group_id, lr.register_dates, TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, lr.register_dates, lr.dates) register_day, count(DISTINCT lr.user_id) retention_user_num from dwd_user_login_record lr INNER JOIN dim_user_lab dul on (dul.user_id = lr.user_id) where dates = #{dates} group by lr.dates, lr.pkg, lr.register_version, lr.register_dates, dul.config_group_type, dul.config_group_id
